string.name: privacy_dialog_body
string.value: When you use nearby device discovery, BlueScopes scans nearby Bluetooth devices on this device and LAN devices advertised via mDNS on your current Wi-Fi (such as name, IP, and port), and reads the current Wi-Fi name for display. Bluetooth permission is used to scan and display nearby Bluetooth devices. Network permission is used to discover LAN devices on the current Wi-Fi. Wi-Fi information permission is used to show the current network name. This works indoors, outdoors, and on any network. Data stays on this device and is not uploaded. Please read the privacy policy before continuing.
